name: Mors
source:
A nun of the "Church" working at the chapel in the Tower.
A pious, devout and quiet woman brimming with compassion, but she's really a Demoness known as the Vampire. When night falls, her personality completely changes as her true nature emerges; she's lascivious and belligerent with her libido at full tilt.  

She carefully selects males who take her fancy amongst the Paladins who offer their prayers in the chapel and gorges herself on their blood.
